mentions.name: hcker.news
mentions.description: Alternative Hacker News interface packed with quality-of-life reading features. Includes an AI filter that can optionally hide GitHub repos with AI authorship, and comments served through its own backend for very fast loading, forming the foundation for upcoming features such as HN feature parity via a browser extension and synced accounts.
mentions.source_excerpt: still working on https://hcker.news, which has an absurd number of features that improve your QoL when reading hn.
